correctness.rationale: The covariance is U(z)/(1-|z|^2), with U the positive Poisson extension of spectral density; the expected Gaussian zero intensity and harmonicity give the exact deficit as (4pi)^-1 disk energy of log U. Fourier coefficients of |2sin(theta/2)|^alpha have Gamma-ratio formula, asymptotic k^(-1-alpha). Unweighted shell Fourier Parseval gives sum k|g_k|^2(1-r^(2k)); its leading asymptotic is eps^(2alpha) for alpha<1/2, eps log(1/eps) at 1/2. Near the unique cusp U tends to baseline a; outer arcs have O(eps) energy, so the nonlinear denominator localizes there. Above 1/2, L2 boundary derivatives yield global Q_alpha eps. Independent quadrature confirmed nine Gamma Fourier coefficients at alpha=.25,.5,.75 and frequencies 1,2,5. No almost-sure zero statement is proved.
residual_risks: Outer-arc regularity and Fourier localization are analytical arguments rather than machine certificates; numerical tests do not prove uniform asymptotic.
